name: DCW post-step bias correction (Spectrum, Haar-band)
plain: Before each new model call at a new sigma, nudges the incoming latent along its difference from the previous step's guided x0, with a weight λ times a sigma schedule (default 1 − σ, which suits flow models). By default only the low-low band of a one-level Haar wavelet of that difference is used; odd latent sizes fall back to the full difference. It edits the sampler's latent in place from inside the cond-batch wrapper. A new step is detected by a change of sigma, so multi-stage samplers will probably trigger it at their substeps too. The node default λ is +0.01, while the module docstring quotes about −0.015 for Anima; an auto mode reads λ per step from a calibrator file.
math:
Symbols: x latent entering the call at σ_i; D_{i−1} previous step's post-CFG x0; λ; s(σ) = 1 − σ (or σ, or 1); M(·) Haar band mask (LL default).
x ← x + λ · s(σ_{i−1}) · IDWT(M(DWT(x − D_{i−1}))); with band 'all': x ← x + λ s(σ_{i−1}) (x − D_{i−1}).
